messages:
maria (oncall): quick sync — follow-up from the postmortem on the p95 latency spikes that recurred last week. we need clear owners for remediation items, SLO adjustments, and dashboard updates before next deploy.
kevin (eng-sre): +1. main cause was continuous batching regression + kvcache misses during cold starts. logs showed bursted queueing around 11:20->11:40.
elena (product): timeline question — do we want to adjust SLO targets now or after remediation? customers are asking about SLA impacts.
raj (eng-platform): i can patch the dashboard and add a temporary tile for per-pool p95 and kvcache hit-rate. will link grafana once done.
sre_oncall_bot: incident #2026 auto-created follow-up ticket: PROD-2026-REM. assigned to kevin by default.
kevin (eng-sre): proposed actions: 1) short-term SLO guardrail: raise p95 alert threshold from 220ms -> 320ms for 72h to avoid noisy alerts while we fix root cause (owner: elena, due: 2027-06-02). 2) remediation PR to reduce batching window + add warmup warm path (owner: raj, due: 2027-06-09). 3) runbook update for cold-starts + kvcache TTL tuning (owner: maria, due: 2027-06-04).
maria (oncall): +ack. i'll take the runbook update. i'll add the exact steps and test checklist.
elena (product): i'll own the SLO guardrail change and coordinate comms to account managers. i'll set the error-budget policy to pause automated rollouts while the temporary threshold is active.
raj (eng-platform): i'll open the platform PR today for batching change, will include load-test results. early plan: lower max batch latency target from 50ms->30ms and add an opt-in warmup request on pod start.
kevin (eng-sre): also propose we add an automatic fallback route to reserve capacity pool if p95 crosses 2x SLO for 5m. that should limit customer-visible impact. owner: kevin, due: 2027-06-08.
maria (oncall): noted. please make the fallback policy idempotent and include metric tags for which model/pool triggered it.
raj (eng-platform): will do. also adding a dashboard panel that graphs fallback triggers vs kvcache hit-rate. link: https://grafana.redwood/s/dash/incident-2026 (placeholder).
sre_oncall_bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy queued for platform PR when ready.
elena (product): can we add a specific evaluation set to Redwood Optimize so we can monitor quality after batching changes? owner: elena, due: 2027-06-10.
kevin (eng-sre): agree — add regression alerts tied to prompts in the eval set. if quality drops >1% vs baseline, auto-roll back.
maria (oncall): action summary (I'll create a follow-up thread in the ticket): - SLO guardrail change (elena) due 2027-06-02 - Runbook update (maria) due 2027-06-04 - Platform PR batching + warmup (raj) due 2027-06-09 - Fallback policy implementation (kevin) due 2027-06-08 - Eval set & regression alert (elena) due 2027-06-10
kevin (eng-sre): thanks — i'll own verification of reduced p95 variance in the next 48h after deploy and will post ETA for any rollback.
elena (product): i'll draft the comms and error budget note for accounts.
maria (oncall): ok team — let's reconvene after the PR lands, i'll update the ticket with owners and milestones. :thumbsup:
